summary: Phase 3 compliance tested end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest pass (public privacy/delete HTML, public deletion form 400/422/429, consent + Elthea 403/200 gating, in-app deletion request idempotency + status, MD list/reject/complete with full erase of a fresh parent incl. students/complaints, payments retained with retained_reason, erased parent login 401 + old token 401, unmatched complete 400, non-MD 403). Frontend all requested flows pass at 375px: first-login privacy consent (Elthea switch off by default, agree -> /parent/home, not shown again), Profile privacy-card (Elthea toggle shows/hides reassess-btn, consent-date, privacy link opens /api/privacy), delete-account sheet -> deletion-pending, rejected status shown back to parent, MD Deletion Requests list (unmatched warning + Delete disabled, reject requires reason, delete -> dr-sheet -> toast -> COMPLETED), public web form (bad phone error, success message). Main finding: the public form rate limit uses the ingress pod IP rather than the client IP, so it does not work as intended.

critical.issue: Rate limit uses request.client.host, which is the k8s ingress pod IP (DB shows only 10.11.1.72 / 10.11.1.73), not the real client. Effect: (a) one client got 9 x 200 before the first 429, because requests are spread across 2 pods; (b) the limit is global, so 5 requests from anyone through one pod in an hour block every other parent for that hour. Use the first entry of X-Forwarded-For (or X-Real-IP), falling back to client.host.

minor.issue: Matching uses phone alone (username is only a fallback), so anyone who knows a parent's phone can file a request that shows as 'matched' with Delete enabled for the MD. Consider requiring phone + username to match, or labelling it 'matched by phone, verify identity' in the MD UI.

Does not delete the parent's password_reset_tokens. The completed deletion_request still keeps parent_name, phone and child_name (username, note and ip are nulled). Decide and document whether these are kept as an audit trail.
matched = bool(parent_id) and does not check that the account still exists. A second pending request for an already-erased parent shows Delete enabled, and complete then returns 400.

The form uses a relative fetch('public/deletion-requests'). If the page is opened as /api/delete-account/ (trailing slash), it posts to the wrong URL. Use the absolute path '/api/public/deletion-requests'.

ui_bugs.issue: Muted did not pass testID through, so testIDs consent-date, deletion-rejected and dr-pending-count were missing from the DOM. FIXED by T1 (added a testID prop).

issues: At 375px the title 'User Management' breaks mid-word ('Managemen' / 't') because the 'Deletion requests' pill squeezes it. Shrink the title, move the pill below it, or use an icon-only button.
open-deletion-requests is 36px tall, below the 44px minimum.
The Elthea Switch hit area is 40x20 on web, below 44px. Make the whole row pressable.
In the off state the switch track uses colors.border on a white card, so it has low contrast and is hard to see.

action_items: HIGH: Base the public deletion-request rate limit on the real client IP (X-Forwarded-For first hop / X-Real-IP), not request.client.host.
Fix the admin/users header title wrapping at 375px, and give the Deletion requests button a touch target of at least 44px.
Consider stricter identity matching for web deletion requests (phone + username), or flag phone-only matches in the MD UI.
Optional: delete password_reset_tokens on erase; use an absolute fetch path on the delete page; make Elthea switch rows fully tappable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2318 lines; consider splitting the compliance routes into their own module.
Parent Profile only uses /students[0], so a parent with several children sees one child.
Home correctly hides start-elthea-btn for Aarav because he already has GROW results (grow-card shown instead). Re-assess is only on Profile, and it is gated correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh TEST_ parents/students (erased via the flows under test), TEST_ web requests, and an anjali request (rejected). All cleaned up: deletion_requests is empty, anjali's privacy_consent_at/elthea_consent are unset again, consent_log entries from the last 3h and orphan retained payments of erased TEST students are deleted, Aarav is intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response key is access_token (not token). Use the class 'Sunshine' for new students. Public rate limit counts per ingress pod IP (10.11.1.72/73); delete TEST_ deletion_requests docs if you hit 429. Never complete a request for anjali.reddy.
rca_of_issue: Rate limit: behind the k8s ingress, request.client.host is the ingress pod IP. Verified via deletion_requests.ip values: 12 rapid requests from one client produced 200 x9, then 429 x3.
